title: 美银Winnie：AI交易仍受追捧，消费刺激不足
speaker: Winnie

segments.en: I think it, again, depends on horizon. For the more Ningbo platform, hedge fund, you know, Kuang fund, no problem at all. The momentum is still there.
segments.zh: 这取决于投资期限。对于量化平台、对冲基金来说，动量依然存在。

segments.en: And the view is at least until next earnings of the hyperscalers, which is like two, three months away. So people, I would say generally, are still quite on the positive side, and there's no compelling alternatives.
segments.zh: 至少到超大规模企业下一次财报（两三个月后），市场情绪依然乐观，且没有有吸引力的替代选择。

segments.en: I think investors have been talking about broadening out of their trade, looking into defense, industrials, whatever, but the conviction elsewhere in terms of earning certainty, the defensible margins are not as strong as AI.
segments.zh: 投资者虽在讨论分散交易，关注国防、工业等，但其他领域的盈利确定性和护城河都不如AI。

segments.en: And even just consumption, right in China, for example. I mean, itself reinforcing in some ways, because you know that they're not the stimulus wise.
segments.zh: 以中国消费为例，某种程度上自我强化，因为政策并非刺激消费。

segments.en: They rather focus on AI, rather focus on advanced manufacturing, not so much consumer demand stimulus.
segments.zh: 政策更侧重AI和先进制造，而非消费需求刺激。
